Student Accommodation

Mercia Lodge: 19 student rooms, Coventry

Coventry, West Midlands201619 photos

Design and build conversion of the unused second floor of a former Travelodge hotel in Coventry city centre into 19 self-contained student rooms, taking the building to 169 rooms. Works included heavy demolition of the old kitchen and cold rooms, 21 new roof lights cut through the concrete roof on new steelwork, metal stud partitions, new hot and cold water and drainage for every room, and active smoke ventilation linked to the fire alarm. Delivered to a fixed deadline for student arrivals, with the building control final certificate issued August 2016.
